verdict.rationale: AWS's own CLI documentation says the CLI implements functionality equivalent to the browser-based Management Console. AWS also publishes machine-readable Smithy models for all public AWS API services, which back the SDKs and CLI, so the console's capabilities are exposed programmatically. Parity is asserted by the vendor rather than demonstrated service by service. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that every console action has an API equivalent, explicit per-service parity documentation or acknowledgment of console-only gaps.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: the AWS CLI enables you to start running commands that implement functionality equivalent to that provided by the browser-based AWS Management Console from the command prompt in your terminal program
you can control multiple AWS services from the command line and automate them through scripts
At AWS, we use Smithy extensively to model our service APIs and provide the daily releases of the AWS SDKs and CLIs
